title: PosScheduleOverrideRequest

start.description: Start time of the override duration in the merchant's local time. If you do not specify a start and end, then the override will take effect immediately.

end.description: End time of the override duration in the merchant's local time. If you do not specify a start and end, then the override will take effect immediately.

type.description: Type of schedule override. "UNAVAILABLE" is a duration when the merchant should be closed, when normally they would be open. "AVAILABLE" is a duration when the merchant should be open, when normally they would be closed.

schedule_name.description: Type of schedule. If not specified, defaults to "DELIVERY"

description: Request body for creating a new schedule override. You must specify both a start or end, or neither. You must include the field schedule_name or by default it will be set to DELIVERY.
